posts.author: levelsio
posts.text:
🎒 Submitted https://t.co/Q4ZVIViJbZ now to most of the MCP directories

For that I had to add OAuth login for users as it doesn't allow just API keys

It works pretty well now inside Claude or ChatGPT, lets you ask where to go next based on current city rankings but also your trips

And it also lets you add, edit or delete trips, and even organize meetups in places you go!

I agree with the philosophy that all of our apps/sites should be MCP/API accessible at feature parity, it'll be probably be quite important I think

posts.text_zh:
🎒 刚把 https://nomads.com/mcp 提交到了大多数 MCP 目录。

为此我得给用户加上 OAuth 登录，因为这些目录不允许只用 API key。

现在它在 Claude 或 ChatGPT 里用起来挺顺的，你可以根据当前的城市排行，也可以结合你自己的旅行记录，问它下一站该去哪儿。

它还能让你添加、编辑或删除旅行记录，甚至能在你要去的地方组织线下聚会！

我认同这样一种理念：我们所有的应用和网站都应该能通过 MCP/API 访问，并且功能和网页端完全对等。我觉得这以后大概会变得相当重要。

posts.author: levelsio
posts.text:
I opened the box form @DHH and it's the Dell XPS 14 with @omarchy loaded on it!

Set up was very easy, fast and flawless, I think it took less than a minute on first opening it

Omarchy asks you lots of questions to set it up for you, kind of like an onboarding, but not in an annoying way like Windows would do these days with too many useless questions, every question here makes sense

It sets up your Git and your AI agent of choice like Codex, Claude Code or OpenCode

Everything worked flawlessly with no bugs at all, really smooth

Then you're inside, and you see the famous Omarchy wallpaper, and then it gets a bit hard (for me at least) because I had to figure out the shortcuts

Luckily @jankeesvw helped me figure them out but I'm still learning

I'll be setting up my SSH to my VPS servers so I can work from there. And also I'd like to see if I can use Claude Code to customize Omarchy to my own liking, like generating my own apps etc.

I'll report back!

Part 2 of the video is in the reply (after I fixed the power)
posts.text_zh:
我拆开了 @DHH 寄来的盒子，是一台预装了 @omarchy 的 Dell XPS 14！

设置过程非常简单、快速、完美，我觉得第一次开机不到一分钟就搞定了

Omarchy 会问你很多问题来帮你完成设置，有点像新手引导，但不像现在的 Windows 那样拿一堆没用的问题烦你，这里的每个问题都有意义

它会帮你配置好 Git 和你选择的 AI 智能体，比如 Codex、Claude Code 或 OpenCode

一切运行完美，没有任何 bug，非常顺滑

然后你就进入系统了，看到那张著名的 Omarchy 壁纸，接下来就有点难了（至少对我来说），因为我得自己摸索快捷键

幸好 @jankeesvw 帮我弄明白了，不过我还在学

我会把 SSH 配置到我的 VPS 服务器上，这样就能在服务器上工作。我还想试试能不能用 Claude Code 按我的喜好定制 Omarchy，比如生成我自己的应用等等

之后再来汇报！

视频第二部分在回复里（在我把电源问题解决之后）
